To allow users to mint on either Ethereum or Solana chain. 
If user decides to mint on the Ethereum chain, then when need to have a smart contract in place to bridge the Ethereum copy of the chain with the original Solana copy that is keep in our custodian.
User should be able to claim their Solana copy from us and the TSD tokens that is accruing while the TSD token is in our custody

Deciding where to mint the NFT will determine how our roll out will be. 

Minting NFTs on Ethereum will gaurantee a large turn out up front but the problem will then be about retaining all these folks 
Minting NFTs on Solana might mean a really low turn out up front and it becomes an uphill battle as we seek to get more folks in. However the trade off is having the time to refine our concept as we figure out Utility market fit
